note: 16 Nov (the owner: "we need to try a rental with qwen3.6 a3b distilled from 3.8, and bobs tools, and real jobs, and see how it does. both before and after our effort changes"; "the small brain gets a 100 real job trial run"; "if our changes to the effort settings for a single brain makes it fail more we will not proceed with that part of the update"). Stock Qwen3.6-35B-A3B (unsloth MTP build, UD-Q4_K_XL) with lododoai's distill add-on (Qwen3.8-27B teacher, Apache 2.0) over it. The add-on first writes the test world of each of 100 jobs (run 3's 45 plus the first 55 fix-list jobs), then five runs of those same jobs at once: before (Effort Low, Effort High as Bob does it today) and after (Effort on one brain at Low, High and Max, PR #279). Tavily: at most 600 searches, counted in lab-kit-shape4's ledger (shared with the Flash-Next run), a query already answered is answered again from the shared cache. The owner, 16 Nov: "if it does we're keeping the output as lessons": Opus 5.5 reads every run; clean runs become lessons as they ran (Bob's own shape-4 tool syntax), the rest are study material and never train. The Flash-Next 800 jobs have search priority. Opus 5.5 grades every run. L40S, 10 slots. Caps 3.5 h / $5.

benchmark.note: one server: stock Qwen3.6-35B-A3B with the distill add-on loaded (each ask sets lora scale 1).

models.name: distill-a3b
models.nickname: Qwen3.6-35B-A3B + Qwen3.8-27B distill add-on, doing Bob's jobs
commands: node jobs-matrix.mjs --prefix distill-a3b --stagger 60 --variants "before-low=--effort low;before-high=--effort high;after-low=--effort low --solo-effort;after-high=--effort high --solo-effort;after-max=--effort extreme --solo-effort --job-minutes 20" --url {{url}} --bob .. --jobs ../../../lab-kit-shape4/bob-model-lab/out/jobs-trial/ideas.jsonl,../../../lab-kit-shape4/bob-model-lab/out/jobs-fix/jobs.jsonl --never ../../../lab-kit-shape4/bob-model-lab/out/jobs-trial/never --count 100 --parallel 2 --want-shapes 4 --max 4096 --hours 2.5 --job-minutes 10 --lora-scale 1 --search tavily --search-probe --search-month 1500 --search-cap 600 --search-ledger ../../../lab-kit-shape4/bob-model-lab/out/tavily-searches-2026-11.json --search-cache ../../bob-model-lab/out/distill-a3b-search-cache.jsonl

prep: Inputs, read only from lab-kit-shape4 (the Flash-Next copy; nothing is written there but the Tavily ledger): out/jobs-trial/ideas.jsonl (run 3's 45 jobs), out/jobs-fix/jobs.jsonl (the first 55), out/jobs-trial/never/ (held-out test files).
--want-shapes 4 stops the run before renting if this copy's tools are any other shape. This copy is branch claude/project-thread-k0vl4g: the Lab of PR #275 plus PR #279 (Effort on one brain).
